title: Big and small letters

parent.learn: Every letter has a capital (big) and a small form: A a, B b.
parent.why: Most writing uses small letters, so the child needs both shapes for the same sound.
A capital letter tells the reader “a new sentence starts here” or “this is someone's name”.

parent.learn: Tricky pairs: b and d, p and q.
parent.why: They are the same shape facing different ways. Trick for b and d: make a “bed” with two fists, thumbs up — the left is b, the right is d.

parent.learn: Some small letters are tall (b, d, h, k, l, t), some hang below the line (g, j, p, q, y).
parent.why: Writing on four-line notebooks needs this, and the outline of a word helps the eye read it.

ask: Write your name. Which letter is a capital?
Find a capital letter and its small letter in a book.
Show me small b and small d with your hands (the bed trick).
Which small letters hang below the line?
Match the fridge-magnet letters: big with small.
Write the small letters a to e.

rounds.t: Which is the small letter for A?
rounds.h: Capital A and small a make the same sound.

rounds.t: Which is the capital letter for b?
rounds.h: Small b grows into capital B.

rounds.t: Which is the small letter for M?
rounds.h: Small m has two humps, like a small M.

rounds.t: Which is the capital letter for e?
rounds.h: Small e and capital E are the same letter.

rounds.t: Which is the small letter for S?
rounds.h: S and s are the same shape — just big and small.

rounds.t: Which is the small letter for D?
rounds.h: Make the “bed” with your fists: the right fist is d, with the bump in front of the stick.

rounds.t: Which is the small letter for G?
rounds.h: Small g has a round top and a tail that curls back.

rounds.t: Which is the capital letter for r?
rounds.h: Small r grows into capital R.

rounds.t: Which pair is the same letter?
rounds.h: T and t are both the letter t.

rounds.t: Which is the capital letter for q?
rounds.h: Q is like O with a little tail.
Names always start with a capital: Ravi, Asha, Delhi.
Only the first letter of a name is a capital: Ravi.

rounds.t: Which small letter hangs below the line?
rounds.h: g has a tail that goes down below the line.
h has a tall stick that reaches up.
A sentence starts with a capital letter and only the first letter is big.
